from typing import List

class Solution:
    def lexicographicallySmallestArray(self, nums: List[int], limit: int) -> List[int]:
        n = len(nums)
        order = sorted(range(n), key=lambda i: nums[i])
        res = [0] * n
        i = 0
        while i < n:
            j = i
            while j + 1 < n and nums[order[j + 1]] - nums[order[j]] <= limit:
                j += 1
            group_idx = sorted(order[i:j + 1])
            group_val = [nums[order[k]] for k in range(i, j + 1)]
            for idx, v in zip(group_idx, group_val):
                res[idx] = v
            i = j + 1
        return res

    def lexicographicallySmallestArray(self, nums: List[int], limit: int) -> List[int]:
        n = len(nums)
        pairs = sorted((v, i) for i, v in enumerate(nums))
        res = [0] * n
        start = 0
        while start < n:
            end = start
            while end + 1 < n and pairs[end + 1][0] - pairs[end][0] <= limit:
                end += 1
            group = pairs[start:end + 1]
            idxs = sorted(i for _, i in group)
            vals = [v for v, _ in group]
            for k, idx in enumerate(idxs):
                res[idx] = vals[k]
            start = end + 1
        return res

class Solution:
    def lexicographicallySmallestArray(self, nums: List[int], limit: int) -> List[int]:
        n = len(nums)
        order = sorted(range(n), key=lambda i: nums[i])
        res = [0] * n
        groups_idx = []
        groups_val = []
        cur_idx = [order[0]]
        cur_val = [nums[order[0]]]
        for k in range(1, n):
            i = order[k]
            v = nums[i]
            if v - cur_val[-1] <= limit:
                cur_idx.append(i)
                cur_val.append(v)
            else:
                groups_idx.append(cur_idx)
                groups_val.append(cur_val)
                cur_idx = [i]
                cur_val = [v]
        groups_idx.append(cur_idx)
        groups_val.append(cur_val)
        for idxs, vals in zip(groups_idx, groups_val):
            idxs.sort()
            for p, v in zip(idxs, vals):
                res[p] = v
        return res
